acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent first-use acquisition never exposes an empty or malformed slot JSON; the existing first-use regression passes repeatedly.
A slot winner is bound to the lease bytes it publishes; a competing Work Item receives a valid distinct slot or a fail-closed capacity result.
The installed public Runtime v0.2.22 records verification evidence for the targeted regression and full required tests pass.
goal: Eliminate the parallel slot EOF race and prove concurrent first-use acquisition is fail-safe and race-safe.
intent: Make first-use parallel lease publication atomic so concurrent Work Items cannot read a partially written lease JSON.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Two Work Items acquiring the first repository-local slots never observe an empty or partial lease JSON; each result is valid or fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the parallel boundary first-use regression repeatedly, the targeted package test, and the full workspace quality suite.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A competing slot publication cannot overwrite another Work Item's lease bytes, and malformed or stale state remains fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: parallel lease publication interruption or collision
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise atomic publication and existing malformed/symlink lease tests, then inspect repository-local evidence and runtime identity.
